updates.title: Epic Games Statuspage API: Service Under Maintenance
Rocket League Matchmaking Outage
updates.meta: Resolved / Major / Resolved / Matchmaking issues have been resolved. Players should now be able to queue into matches normally.

updates.title: Rocket League Matchmaking Outage
updates.meta: Identified / Major / Resolved / We're working to resolve an issue where players are unable to matchmake. We'll provide another update when this is fixed.

updates.title: Login and Matchmaking Errors
updates.meta: Resolved / Major / Resolved / Log-in and Matchmaking has recovered and we're no longer seeing any server delays. We'll continue to monitor these services and address any issues that arise.

updates.title: Login and Matchmaking Errors
updates.meta: Investigating / Major / Resolved / We're actively working to fix the Log-in & Matchmaking outages players are experiencing across Fortnite, Fall Guys, and Rocket League. Purchases on Epic Games Store may encounter a delay. We'll provide more info as we resolving this issue.

updates.title: Login and Matchmaking Errors
updates.meta: Investigating / Major / Resolved / Players may not be able to log into or matchmake in Fortnite or Fall Guys. We're working to fix this now and we'll provide an update when we have more info.

updates.title: Issues with Publishing Tools and Developer Portal
updates.meta: Resolved / Major / Resolved / This incident has been resolved.

updates.title: Issues with Publishing Tools and Developer Portal
updates.meta: Investigating / Major / Resolved / We are currently investigating issues impacting Epic Games Store Publishing Tools and the Epic Online Services Developer Portal. We'll share an update once they are resolved.

updates.title: Fortnite Matchmaking Issues
updates.meta: Resolved / Critical / Resolved / ✅ Matchmaking errors are fixed. Players can jump into a game again without issue. We're monitoring game servers to make sure everything returns to normal.

updates.title: Fortnite Matchmaking Issues
updates.meta: Investigating / Critical / Resolved / 🛠️ We are aware that players are currently experiencing matchmaking issues. We are working on resolving these issues ASAP.
